---
params:
  parquet_path: ""
  activity_id: ""
  activity_name: ""
  activity_type: ""
  smooth_window: 5
  max_points: 600
---

```{r}
#| output: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(nanoparquet)
library(slider)

d <- nanoparquet::read_parquet(params$parquet_path)

# Not every activity carries every column. addcols_distance() and
# addcols_speed() are only applied when the stream has coordinates, so an
# indoor activity legitimately arrives with no distance, speed or pace at all,
# and a recordless file arrives with no rows. Everything below is guarded.
hascol <- function(nm) nm %in% names(d) && any(!is.na(d[[nm]]))
has_rows  <- nrow(d) > 0
has_time  <- has_rows && hascol("time")
has_dist  <- has_rows && hascol("distance")
has_speed <- has_rows && hascol("speed")
has_pace  <- has_rows && hascol("pace")
has_hr    <- has_rows && hascol("heartrate")
has_alt   <- has_rows && hascol("altitude")
has_gps   <- has_rows && hascol("lat") && hascol("lng")

fmt_pace <- function(min_per_km) {
  if (!is.finite(min_per_km)) return("\u2014")
  mins <- floor(min_per_km)
  secs <- round((min_per_km - mins) * 60)
  if (secs == 60L) { mins <- mins + 1L; secs <- 0L }
  sprintf("%d:%02d", mins, secs)
}

fmt_duration <- function(s) {
  if (!is.finite(s)) return("\u2014")
  h <- floor(s / 3600); m <- floor((s %% 3600) / 60); ss <- round(s %% 60)
  if (h > 0) sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, ss) else sprintf("%d:%02d", m, ss)
}

smooth_centered <- function(x, w) {
  slider::slide_dbl(x, mean, na.rm = TRUE, .before = w, .after = w)
}

total_dist_km <- if (has_dist) max(d$distance, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000 else NA_real_
total_time_s  <- if (has_time) max(d$time, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
avg_pace_mpk  <- if (isTRUE(total_dist_km > 0) && is.finite(total_time_s)) {
  (total_time_s / 60) / total_dist_km
} else NA_real_
avg_hr      <- if (has_hr)  mean(d$heartrate, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
elev_gain_m <- if (has_alt) sum(pmax(0, diff(d$altitude)), na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

# Plot against distance where it exists, and fall back to elapsed time so that
# indoor activities still get their series charted. The replacement has to
# match nrow(d): a recordless stream is a legitimate 0-row frame, and assigning
# a scalar into one is an error rather than a recycle.
d$xvar <- if (has_dist) {
  d$distance / 1000
} else if (has_time) {
  d$time / 60
} else {
  rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
}
xlab <- if (has_dist) "Distance (km)" else if (has_time) "Time (min)" else ""

if (has_pace && has_speed) {
  # Dead-band the stationary stretches, where pace explodes towards infinity.
  d$pace_sm <- smooth_centered(
    if_else(d$speed < 0.3, NA_real_, d$pace), params$smooth_window
  )
}
if (has_hr) d$hr_sm <- smooth_centered(d$heartrate, params$smooth_window)

date_str <- if (has_rows && hascol("timestamp")) {
  format(min(d$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
} else ""

# Thinning and rounding, applied only to what the charts consume. Every
# statistic above is computed from the full stream first, and the smoothing
# windows are applied at full resolution, so the numbers shown do not depend
# on max_points. A dense multi-hour stream runs to tens of thousands of points
# that no chart can resolve, and each one costs roughly ten characters of JSON
# inside the rendered page.
#
# max_points = 0 keeps every point, for rendering a single activity at full
# resolution.
keep <- params$max_points
idx <- if (!is.numeric(keep) || length(keep) != 1L || !is.finite(keep) ||
  keep <= 0 || nrow(d) <= keep) {
  seq_len(nrow(d))
} else {
  unique(round(seq(1, nrow(d), length.out = keep)))
}
d <- d[idx, ]

# Trailing digits that no axis can show. Coordinates to five decimals is
# roughly metre resolution, which is finer than the fixes themselves.
round_if <- function(d, nm, digits) {
  if (nm %in% names(d)) d[[nm]] <- round(d[[nm]], digits)
  d
}
d <- d |>
  round_if("xvar", 3) |>
  round_if("altitude", 1) |>
  round_if("pace_sm", 2) |>
  round_if("hr_sm", 0) |>
  round_if("lat", 5) |>
  round_if("lng", 5)

nz <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) NULL else x
title_main <- nz(params$activity_name)
if (is.null(title_main)) title_main <- params$activity_id
heading <- paste(
  c(title_main, nz(params$activity_type), nz(date_str)),
  collapse = " \u00b7 "
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat("# ", heading, "\n\n")
```

## Summary

```{r}
tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Distance", "Duration", "Avg pace", "Avg HR", "Elev gain"),
  Value = c(
    if (is.finite(total_dist_km)) sprintf("%.2f km", total_dist_km) else "\u2014",
    fmt_duration(total_time_s),
    if (is.finite(avg_pace_mpk)) paste0(fmt_pace(avg_pace_mpk), " /km") else "\u2014",
    if (has_hr) sprintf("%.0f bpm", avg_hr) else "\u2014",
    if (has_alt) sprintf("%.0f m", elev_gain_m) else "\u2014"
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Route

```{r}
if (has_gps) {
  coords <- d |>
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lng)) |>
    select(lng, lat) |>
    as.matrix()
  leaflet(coords) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
    addPolylines(color = "#2c3e50", weight = 4, opacity = 0.85)
} else {
  "No GPS data."
}
```

## Elevation profile

```{r}
if (has_alt && nzchar(xlab)) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(xvar, altitude)) +
    geom_area(fill = "#95a5a6", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = "#34495e") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Altitude (m)") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y"))
} else {
  "No altitude data."
}
```

## Pace

```{r}
if (has_pace && has_speed && nzchar(xlab)) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(xvar, pace_sm)) +
    geom_line(color = "#2980b9", alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Pace (min/km)") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y"))
} else {
  "No pace data."
}
```

## Heart rate

```{r}
if (has_hr && nzchar(xlab)) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(xvar, hr_sm)) +
    geom_line(color = "#c0392b", alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Heart rate (bpm)") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y"))
} else {
  "No heart rate data."
}
```
